_comment: Maps an EpgRow id (or its watchUrl) to a playout source on the OFFICE server. Copy to media-map.json and fill in. Source = absolute file path for pre-recorded content, or a live-input URL (rtmp://127.0.0.1/relay/<name>, srt://...) for an OBS-driven live event. Any program with no entry here is left to ffplayout's filler so a wrong file never airs. EpgRow ids look like ep_<id>, stream_<id>, match_<id>; watchUrls look like /show/<slug>/1/1, /stream/<id>, /events/<id>.
